notablePrerequisites: Halo Fountain does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Halo Fountain to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Halo Fountain's first ability by paying {W}, tapping it and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Citizen, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 2.
